title: Minimax properties of gamma kernel density estimators under $L^p$ loss and $β$-Hölder smoothness of the target
summary: This paper considers the asymptotic behavior in $β$-Hölder spaces, and under $L^p$ loss, of the non-modified gamma kernel density estimator introduced by Chen (Annals of the Institute of Statistical Mathematics, 52, 471-480, 2000) for the analysis of nonnegative data, in the situation where the target may have a finite effective or true upper endpoint but the estimator itself is left untruncated and treats the support as $[0,\infty)$.
